description.p: A minimal wallpaper application that selects wallpapers from online sources and matches them to your desktop's light or dark appearance, so dark mode never gets a blinding white wallpaper.

This is a community package: it downloads Valhalla's official portable build from the project's releases at install time and runs it unmodified. The wallpaper is applied through the XDG desktop portal, and the headless refresh daemon can be started from the app's "start at login" switch.
